cohort: 1992 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section
finding: Mild thrombocytopenia was associated with significantly higher EBLV and excessive blood loss ratios compared to the control group, but there was no significant difference in the need for blood transfusion.
mod_finding: Mild thrombocytopenia appears to increase the likelihood of peripartum hemorrhage in elective cesarean deliveries in uncomplicated pregnancies.
